reviews.quote: Best Wedding Event Team in Vadakara Shadhi Catering & Event made our wedding day perfect! They were professional, organized, and really listened to what we wanted. reviews.quote: last month we hired shadi catering for my friend's engagement function, and they made our special day favorable, the food was delicious and tasty they catered to our special menu needs without any issues, and the entire process was smooth from start to finish.
